title: Tokenizer framing shim + role-escape normalization for cross-model onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: When onboarding new model bundles we observe intermittent message-framing mismatches and escaped role markers that lead to subtle prompt drift and token-count variance. This ticket implements a lightweight 'framing shim' that normalizes leading/trailing control tokens and a role-escape normalization pass that preserves semantic delimiters across tokenizer variants. The shim will run as part of the onboarding pipeline, emit divergence telemetry, and gate performance-profile publishing if tokenization drift exceeds configurable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Framing shim implemented and exercised in onboarding pipeline for at least three model families (LlamaX, Redford-7B, Bloom-4B)
Delta metric (token-stream edit distance and role-delimiter preservation rate) computed and stored in onboarding artifact for each model version
Profile publishing blocked when divergence > 2.5% token-count or when role delimiters are lost in >0.5% of canonical prompts
Integration tests validate that existing pinned models show no regressions in 95th percentile token counts for our canonical prompt set
Rollout plan documented and canary route configured to pin old tokenizer behavior for affected customers
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run onboarding tokenization for model bundle with existing templates repo on canonical_prompts_v2
2) Observe framing tokens added or removed (e.g., stray <|SYS|> marker or missing newline separator) when compared to reference tokenizer
3) Send the same prompt through runtime generation for pinned model and new model, confirm role labels are misaligned in >1% cases
4) See performance profile publish attempt succeed despite tokenization drift (this ticket should prevent that)
